title: Metabolite Extraction Protocol for Soluble Metabolites
author: Nicholas Sherman
materials: Injection volume of each sample: 10 µL

steps.title: Load samples into reinforced tubes
steps.instruction: Place 100 µL of frozen tissue slice or lyophilized stool into reinforced tubes; for cell pellets, mix the pellet with 50–100 µL water transfer solution, suspend the cells, and transfer the suspension (≈100 µL) to reinforced tubes.

steps.title: Add steel balls and solvent
steps.instruction: Add five stainless‑steel balls to each tube, then add 750 µL of –20 °C cold chloroform:methanol (2:1) mixture.

steps.title: Bead‑mill disruption
steps.instruction: Disrupt cells/tissues using a Fisher Bead Mill 24 at 5 m/s for 20 s, perform three cycles with a 10 s dwell/pause between runs.

steps.title: Vortex and shake on ice
steps.instruction: Vortex the tubes briefly, then place them in a temperature‑controlled shaker set to 4 °C and shake vigorously for 30 min.

steps.title: Add water and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of water, shake vigorously, and centrifuge for 10 min at 10 000 rpm to achieve phase separation.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Recover the upper aqueous methanolic phase and transfer it to a clean Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Dry extracts and store
steps.instruction: Dry the soluble metabolite extracts under vacuum for 3–4 h, then store at –80 °C until LC‑MS(/MS) analysis.

steps.title: Reconstitute for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Reconstitute each dried sample in 100 µL of 0.1 % formic acid in water containing 100× diluted Metabolomics QReSS heavy‑labeled standards.

steps.title: Prepare QC pool
steps.instruction: Combine 10 µL of each sample to make a QC pool, then transfer 50 µL of the pool into autosampler vials.
